name: Adenine riboswitch (Mg2+ form) bound to adenine
source: RCSB PDB 4TZX; Reining A et al. Nature 2013 doi:10.1038/nature12575
notes: Adenine riboswitch from V. vulnificus grown in Mg2+ — companion to 1Y26 (no Mg form). Tests Mg2+ effect on aptamer scoring for free-base ligand. ADE at X:101. 2.01A X-ray.
